title: Planting A Rainbow
author: Lois Ehlert

hero.name: Rainbow garden / colourful flowers
hero.description: The book has no single named character — the hero concept is a vibrant rainbow of garden flowers growing from bulbs and seeds. A generic flower or rainbow image works well.
hero.source_note: Generic colourful flower cluster — a Boardmaker flower or rainbow image is sufficient

ambiguous.issue: Could mean the liquid noun or the action verb (to water plants)
ambiguous.reason: In this book watering plants is the key action — a watering can image captures both the act and the gardening context clearly

notes: Planting A Rainbow by Lois Ehlert is a concept book centred on colours and the gardening cycle (bulbs, seeds, seedlings, blooms). Several icons are already available in activity_images (seed, seedling, soil, plant, watering_can, flower, rain, sunny) and should be reused where possible. The fringe prioritises the six colours featured in the book's rainbow sequence (red, orange, yellow — the three listed here plus green, blue, violet could fill a larger board) alongside key gardening nouns and the single key action 'grow'. Because the book has no named character, the hero cell is best filled with a bright composite flower/rainbow image to anchor the book visually for students.

matching.note: Min 4 approved stems, no hard cap
